scope: Ordinary native-local video/subtitle paths with actual independent Go SDK processes, SQLite and filesystem; exclusive synthetic payloads only

external_transfer.permission: source snapshot, exact absent target and real parent identity frozen before provider call
external_transfer.result: explicit softlink/local file declaration and exact target required
external_transfer.physical: real symlink entry, exact absolute reference and unchanged ordinary referent verified before adoption
external_transfer.cold_recovery: asset SQL failure, graceful app close/reopen, original sealed result reused without provider replay

source_storage.state: call-start identity plus sealed result, then exact entry snapshot and normal exclusive-rename publication
source_storage.cold_recovery: task cancelled after real returned result persisted but before staged snapshot; app reopened with a different SDK PID; original stage inode reused
source_storage.calls: one actual source call per video/subtitle, including recovery
source_storage.false_or_copy: no native fallback, no published target or asset ownership

workers: existing transfer-events and transfer-event-override output paths rebuilt in place, no versioned worker replicas
not_claimed: owned-link file manager and mode UI/browser verification
